THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. CO/DSO/2021/05 dated of 14.11.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Pepiliyana (within the Urban Council limits of Boralesgamuwa) in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 535 of Pepiliyana West in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of the Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Madangahaowita alias Bakmeegahaowita – Extent: 0.0114 Hectare North: Lands bearing Assmt. Nos. 465/23A, 327/6, 327/5, 327/4C, 327/4, 327/3, 327/2A and 327/2; East: Lands bearing Assmt. Nos. 465/23A, 327/6, 327/5, 327/4C, 327/4, 327/3, 327/2A and 327/2 and Road; South: Lots D and B; West: Lots D, B, canal and land bearing Assmt. No. 465/23A at Ranasinghe Mawatha.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Extent: 0.0278 Hectare North: Canal, lands bearing Assmt. Nos. 465/23A at Ranasinghe Mawatha and Lot A; East: Lot A; South: Lots A, D and C; West: Lots D, C, Madangahaowita alias Bakmeegahaowita claimed by M. Disanayake and canal.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Madangahaowita alias Bakmeegahaowita – Extent: 0.0197 Hectare North: Madangahaowita alias Bakmeegahaowita claimed by M. Disanayake, canal and Lot B; East: Lot B; South and West: Lot D, Road and Madangahaowita alias Bakmeegahaowita claimed by M. Disanayake.

04. Lot ‘D’ – Extent: 0.0019 Hectare North and East: Lots C, B, A, lands bearing Assmt. Nos. 327/2 at Ranasinghe Mawatha and Road; South: Road; West: Road and Madangahaowita alias Bakmeegahaowita claimed by M. Disanayake.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
Ref. No.: 4-3/4/2020/LRB/196.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.11th December, 2023.
